entry.long_trigger: previous close <= previous EMA20 and current close > current EMA20
entry.short_trigger: previous close >= previous EMA20 and current close < current EMA20
entry.confirmation: Latest completed 4h candle has matching ordering and closes beyond EMA20 in the setup direction

risk.trend_exit: Completed 1h close crosses EMA50 against the position

ai_role: Asynchronous evidence review and explanation; cannot originate or change a signal
execution: Signals and paper tracking only; no exchange orders
